rounds.text: Despite headline earnings growth, the company suffers from a severe disconnect between reported profits and actual cash generation, with operating cash flow for March 2026 registering at just Rs 0 Cr and cash conversion standing at a concerning 0.00x [E24, E25]. This cash crunch is further evidenced by a negative free cash flow of Rs -7 Cr and operating cash flow making up only 26% of operating profit in March 2026, which points directly to heavy strain from receivables and accruals [E24, E26, E27]. Operational efficiency is deteriorating concurrently, as working capital days have more than doubled from 28.3 days to 60.9 days [E44]. This fundamental weakness has not gone unnoticed by institutional smart money, which has fled the stock heavily, resulting in negative money flow and a sharp drop in foreign institutional ownership from 6.31% to 0.13% alongside a decline in domestic institutional holdings [E32, E33, E34, E50]. Consequently, the market price reflects this underlying distress by sitting merely 5% of the way up its 52-week range and suffering a compounded share price loss of -27% over the past year [E5, E16]. Conceded: the company maintains a low debt-to-equity ratio of 0.03x alongside strong reported return metrics and expanding operating margins [E8, E20, E22, E28].
